code: const EMAILJS_ENDPOINT='https://api.emailjs.com/api/v1.0/email/send';const EMAIL_TIMEOUT_MS=10000;const withTimeout=promise=>Promise.race([promise,new Promise((_,reject)=>{setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('Email request timed out')),EMAIL_TIMEOUT_MS);})]);const getEmailConfig=()=>({serviceId:process.env.REACT_APP_EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID,templateId:process.env.REACT_APP_EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID,publicKey:process.env.REACT_APP_EMAILJS_PUBLIC_KEY});const formatSubmission=formData=>{const excludedFields=new Set(['resumeFileNameFile','portfolioFileNameFile','resumeFileNamePreview','portfolioFileNamePreview']);return Object.entries(formData).filter(_ref=>{let[fieldName,value]=_ref;return!excludedFields.has(fieldName)&&value;}).map(_ref2=>{let[fieldName,value]=_ref2;return"".concat(fieldName,": ").concat(value);}).join('\n');};export const sendSubmissionEmail=async formData=>{const{serviceId,templateId,publicKey}=getEmailConfig();if(!serviceId||!templateId||!publicKey||!formData.email){return{sent:false,configured:false};}try{await withTimeout(fetch(EMAILJS_ENDPOINT,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({service_id:serviceId,template_id:templateId,user_id:publicKey,template_params:{to_email:formData.email,applicant_name:"".concat(formData.firstName||''," ").concat(formData.lastName||'').trim(),form_responses:formatSubmission(formData)}})}).then(async response=>{if(!response.ok){throw new Error("Email service returned ".concat(response.status));}}));return{sent:true,configured:true};}catch(error){console.error('Submission email failed:',error);return{sent:false,configured:true};}};
